meaning:
ὑπο-δείκνυμι
[in LXX for נָגַד hi., etc. ;]
1. to show secretly.
2. to show by tracing out; hence, generally, to teach, make known: with dative of person(s), Luk.6:47 12:5, Act.9:16; id. with inf., Mat.3:7, Luk.3:7; before, ὅτι, Act.20:35.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to…
He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”
